mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 2% month-over-month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing investor confidence and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 1% month-over-month signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and discount rate compression, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 103.5 signals a robust supply-side expansion, reducing the risk premium on equities and compressing discount rates, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in supply-side activity, increasing the risk premium on equities and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over 3 months signals a cooling inflationary environment, reducing the risk premium on equities and compressing discount rates, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in cooling periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 238 signals a heating inflationary environment, increasing the risk premium on equities and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in heating periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
